notes: Levels: L2 = read in the decompile with callers listed; L1 = pattern/scan derived. No item here is runtime-confirmed yet.

props_read_by_init: fnv1a32 key immediates found in the class init and one level of callees, resolved against every exe string and every stock .ui name; element-base keys are listed once in element_base_props and apply to every class whose init_calls_element_base is true.

native_pins: pin ids compared in the class vt+0x190 pin handler and one level of callees; the pin-id globals were read from the running game (they are djb2 values filled at startup) and resolved by name. A lower bound: deeper handlers and custom commands (slot 2) add more.
stock: what shipping .ui files use per class (catalogue of 508 fragments); observed, not a code limit.
Hashes: node ids and pins are djb2 (5381, *33+c) of the path / name; !pkg object keys are fnv1a32.

error_codes.5: unreadable data, wrong value shape, FourCC mismatch, or no factory
error_codes.0x23: screen loader: build job queued (not an error)
error_codes.0x57: bad enum value (F1TS) / node handed to a factory (screen job)
error_codes.0x58: duplicate template name (rest of the resource dropped)

rules.check: A node is an 8-slot array: [props obj, children[], commands[], events[], layout[], components[], behaviours[], slot7]. Slots 6 and 7 are optional (count > 6 / > 7). Every slot must be a readable !pkg array/object; props must hold name (key fnv1a32 0x8d39bde6) and type FourCC (0x5127f14d).
type FourCC must have a factory: 97 neon classes (Vm_Register_NodeClasses 0x14419b1d0) plus the game classes registered by 0x1437ea4a0 (F1xx, TILE, LCDC, OSPL, RSCM, TACM, TADM, UISS). See classes.
Element init re-reads the class FourCC (vt+0x80) and compares it with the record type; mismatch -> 5.
Element classes: slot 4 (layout) is [path]; only path = slot4[0] is read. An empty path array -> 0x22. An empty slot 4 means no layout attach (allowed).

Each path step: if it has isComponentId (0x1613e20d) it must have componentId (0x14018abd, u64) -> step kind 1; otherwise it must have nodeId (0x181e12b8, u32), componentId optional -> step kind 0. Missing key -> 3. Steps are stored in the attach behaviour (vt 0x145a73fa0) +0x20, 0x30 bytes each; multi-step paths are normal in stock (2-6 steps). Resolution against the .idf happens later at attach time, not at load.
Element classes: slot 5 (components) first entry must have name (0x8d39bde6) and componentId (0x14018abd); debugName optional. Missing -> 3.

Element classes: every slot 6 entry needs type (0x5127f14d) else 3; the type is looked up in the behaviour registry (uisys+0x10, 0x144161470); unknown types are skipped; each created behaviour runs its own from-data init (vt+0x28) and a non-zero rc becomes the node rc.

A node whose slot 6 lists NBVN (type 1314275918, visual navigation) must have a visualNav object prop (fnv1a32 0x13eff3de; stock: {xOffset, yOffset}). NBVN init reads it first; missing -> 3 and the node (for a template root: the whole instance) is rejected. Stock pairs them exactly: every root with visualNav lists NBVN and none without it does (f1_world_activity lists neither).

Behaviour from-data inits (vtable slot 5, +0x28) and the props they read: NBVN 0x144289830 visualNav (required) then autoFocus, allowXNav, allowYNav, xOffset, yOffset, navEnabled (optional); NBMO 0x144280780 materialData (optional, missing returns 0); NBEL 0x14427fd50 hideOnUnbind (optional); NBAN 0x14427e320 handleRepeats (optional); NBAC 0x14427dfd0 audioContext (optional); NBDC, NBVM, NBXA, NBTP 0x1438d50b0 read nothing. NBMG, NBFC and NBOS are not registered behaviour types (no code references them) and are skipped.
Slot 2 entries: key command (djb2 id, fnv key 0x93594ab2) required and signals (0xc3c68e0e) required (empty array allowed); commandName is not read.
Slot 3 entries: key event (0xfe30d09f) required and signals required (empty array allowed); eventName not read.

Each signal: to_pin (0x40d4ab10, djb2 of the pin name) and to_object (0x0c3e545e, djb2 of the full authored node path) required -> else 3. attributes (0xe1ffdb94) optional; attribute values are {value[,dbentry]} objects; mappings (0xcedfea42) entries need value -> else 3. to_object_name, to_pin_name, from_pin_name are never read.
UITG, UITB, UILT, UIL2, UIEL: data must be {value, dbentry} with a non-empty dbentry (no dbentry key -> 3; missing, not an object or empty dbentry -> 5).
SVCD: Vm_ElementBase_Init rules, then dbEntry (0xfe80e13d) and comparison_op (0xd07f8d2e) optional, value (0x425ed3ca) required (its read rc is returned).
F1TS: element rules; inputType (0x289cf243), when present, must be normal or dpadOnly (case-insensitive), else 0x57. Other props are not checked.
UISC root: a screen of the same name is already registered with a priority (byte read from key 0x4671ae97) >= the new one -> 0x55 (screen skipped, job continues); a lower one is replaced.

Template names are global across every loaded .ui (store at *(uisys->vt[0x48]()+0x8168), keyed by name string). A second template with an existing name -> Vm_Load_UidfTemplates returns 0x58 and the UIDF handler stops: later templates of that resource are never registered and its tracker is destroyed.

Template instance build: the first child with rc != 0 stops the build; the rc propagates to every ancestor and to the instance. The partially built tree is NOT detached or destroyed: each node attaches to its parent after its own init succeeds and before its children are built, so a descendant failure leaves the root and every node built before it attached, while a root whose own init fails is never attached (the object leaks).

fail.scope: whole template instance (partial tree leaks under the parent)

rules.check: After a successful build: signal to_object ids inside the template are remapped to instance ids (ids not in the template stay, no error); root vt+0x58; root vt+0x50(ctx) rc becomes the instance rc.

Screen build job: any node rc other than 0 / 0x57 (handed to a factory) aborts the screen; ScreenDone with rc not in {0, 0x55} ends the WHOLE job: this screen and every later screen of the same .ui are dropped. No log.

fail.scope: screen + later screens of the job

silently_ignored: Unknown template name at instantiation: every caller skips it (UITC 0x144267110, 0x144178270, 0x144253930...).
Template instance failure: UITC returns NULL (0x144266e30), callers ignore it; no log on any channel.
UITC instance names always embed the content_template value, also for header instances: tab_<n>( <content template> ) can be a header_template instance.

Signal target id not found at link time: Vm_Link_NodeReference 0x144179da0 registers a pending link (0x1442238b0) and resolves it when a node with that id appears; until then Vm_Dispatch_EventSignals 0x144251800 skips the signal.
Pin the target class does not handle: delivered through target vt+0x190; no error path in the dispatcher.
Event not declared on the node, or an event with zero signals: Vm_Raise_NodeEvent 0x1442468d0 returns 0.
Signal ids outside the template are not remapped (left as authored ids): Vm_Remap_InstanceSignals 0x144349300.
Unknown behaviour type in slot 6: skipped (0x144161470 lookup).

Observed, not read in code: stock UIGP nodes receive navUp/navDown/navLeft/navRight signals while declaring those names only as events (132/135/42/122 event declarations, 0 commands), so a pin that matches one of the target node events re-raises it.
commandName / eventName / to_object_name / to_pin_name / from_pin_name / debugName strings: never read by the loader (hashes only).

order_dependent.what: template store is global by name
order_dependent.why: load order of two resident .ui resources that share a template name decides which one wins; the loser drops all later templates (0x58).
a signal whose target is created later stays unlinked until that node exists; anything fired before is dropped.

order_dependent.what: UITC tab instantiation runs on the data-context message
order_dependent.why: tab templates are instantiated when the tab controller receives its data context (tabs[] VM array), after the container VM builds its tab VMs (0x141a76130); the era tile builder (FeTile_Build_EraTiles 0x141a6e980, core site 0x141a6f728) may run before or after.

F1TS dataContext and SVCD dbEntry are stored as paths, not checked at init; Vm_GetOrCreate_ListChild keeps an existing child only if it is a list node, otherwise it creates one, so a node created earlier with another kind under the same name is not the node core fills (inferred, not runtime-confirmed).
